items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Had Big Bill from Chicago... Big Bill had on some tight shoes were hurtin' his feet. He would stand up on the stage playin' and cryin'.

ctx.x: During World War Number Two. And, uh, we were runnin' back and forth to New York an' all over the country. Gettin' back to New York, I was uh...forgot to tell you that the first blues show that ever was at Carnegie Hall, John Hammond gave it, an' I was on the show. Had Big Bill from Chicago, a host of other blues singers... Big Bill had on some tight shoes were hurtin' his feet. He would stand up on the stage playin' and cryin'.
